<p align="center"><strong>Wake the silver flower without flooding its roots.</strong></p>

<p align="center"><small><strong>Inventory:</strong> Brass key &middot; Black cat companion</small></p>


<p align="center">Inside the glass-block greenhouse, a silver flower grows in soil that has never seen daylight. Beyond the panes, carved pumpkin faces turn slowly away from it.</p>

<p align="center">Three valves feed its planter: sun, rain and moon. A botanical notebook lies on the stone shelf. Something taps against the glass when you look down.</p>

<p align="center">Your cat stays beside the silver flower. Its reflection watches a different window.</p>
